suggested_new_group.reason_existing_groups_insufficient: Existing death_by_fate covers death attributed to destiny, but not personified fate figures governing destiny more broadly.

suggestions.label: Threefold colored substance generates natural kinds
suggestions.rationale: A differentiated substance generating natural kinds fits creation from primordial material and elemental separation.
suggestions.cautions: If the passage is a localized etiology for species or materials rather than cosmic creation, keep as granular evidence and review for over-specificity.

suggestions.label: threefold delayed rescue attempt
suggestions.rationale: A repeated delayed rescue can function as an ordeal or quest-sequence episode within heroic narrative.
suggestions.cautions: May be only a plot-structure detail; source context is needed before indexing as rescue, initiation, or sacred combat.

suggestions.label: Threefold escalation of victories and restitution
suggestions.rationale: Escalating victories with restitution suggests a conflict sequence resolving through compensation or restored order.
suggestions.cautions: Could belong under sacred_exchange if restitution is the main function, or be an over-specific narrative pattern.

suggestions.label: threefold ultimatum before conflict
suggestions.rationale: A formal ultimatum repeated before battle is a structured pre-conflict ritual or warfare convention.
suggestions.cautions: If framed as legal warning or covenantal summons, sacred_law or covenant may be secondary; avoid treating the number three alone as a motif.

batch_notes: Several labels use threefold repetition; this should not by itself determine placement unless the passage shows ritual, cosmological, or narrative function.
The two fate-figure labels suggest a durable gap for personified destiny figures broader than death_by_fate.

reviewer_status.notes: Provisional batch suggestions; fate-figure candidate should be reviewed for possible addition as a canonical normalization group.

suggestions.label: tide-controlling royal objects
suggestions.rationale: Royal objects that control tides are power objects conferring sacred or sovereign ability.
suggestions.cautions: Could also relate to sacred_waters or royal_legitimacy depending on whether the passage emphasizes sea control, kingship, or the object itself.

suggestions.label: Tide-dependent magical container
suggestions.rationale: A magical container whose power or operation depends on tides fits the sacred vessel/container group.
suggestions.cautions: If the tide relation is the main motif, sacred_waters may be a secondary mapping; verify it is not merely an episode-specific object detail.

suggestions.label: time as reaper
suggestions.suggested_group_label: Death Attributed to Fate or Destiny
suggestions.rationale: Personified time harvesting lives aligns with death assigned by impersonal destiny or cosmic necessity.
suggestions.cautions: May be poetic metaphor rather than narrative motif; if only a literary image, consider excluding from pattern queries.

suggestions.label: token proving an otherwise unbelievable encounter
suggestions.rationale: A token serving as proof of a hidden or extraordinary encounter functions as a meaningful power object or sign.
suggestions.cautions: This may be a generic folktale proof-device rather than a sacred object; source context should determine whether to map, exclude, or create a broader recognition-token group later.

suggestions.label: token proving chastity or kept faith
suggestions.rationale: A token proving fidelity centers on love, loyalty, and preserved relational commitment.
suggestions.cautions: Could alternatively belong to sacred_treasures if the object’s power matters more than fidelity, or sacred_law if it functions as legal proof in an accusation.

suggestions.label: token removed as accusation of faithlessness
suggestions.rationale: Removal of a token to accuse faithlessness is a fidelity-and-love ordeal centered on trust and loyalty.
suggestions.cautions: May be too episode-specific; if the token itself has independent magical authority, sacred_treasures may be a secondary placement.

suggestions.label: tracker-investigator follows a missing relative’s trail
suggestions.rationale: The label could describe quest, kinship search, tracking skill, or an episode-specific investigation.
suggestions.cautions: Culturally specific source context is needed; do not force into hero_journey unless the search functions as a transformative quest or return pattern.

suggestions.label: traditional skewered meat over ashes
suggestions.rationale: The label reads as a culinary or ethnographic detail rather than a symbolic narrative motif.
suggestions.cautions: If the passage frames the meat as sacrificial offering, feast, or ritual exchange, remap to sacrifice or sacred_exchange with the cooking detail preserved as evidence.

suggestions.label: tragic duel between former fellow pupils
suggestions.rationale: A tragic duel belongs broadly with ritually or narratively charged single combat.
suggestions.cautions: The former-fellow-pupils detail is probably episode-specific; if grief or recognition is central, lament_and_mourning may be a secondary mapping.

suggestions.label: trance through concentration
suggestions.rationale: Concentration-induced trance fits contemplative discipline on an interior mystical path.
suggestions.cautions: If the passage emphasizes vision or revelation received in trance, dream_and_vision or theophany may be secondary; review Sufi terminology carefully.

batch_notes: Several token motifs may point to a future recognition/proof-token grouping, but current occurrences are single and can be provisionally placed by function.
Object-plus-water motifs should preserve whether the object, water/tide control, or sovereignty is primary.
One suggestion uses relationship meta_artifact for an otherwise mapped contemplative practice because the allowed relationship enum lacks a direct discipline/practice variant.

reviewer_status.notes: Draft placements only; source passages should be checked for single-occurrence and culturally specific labels.

suggestions.label: transference of evil or affliction to a substitute
suggestions.rationale: The label matches scapegoat/ritual transfer logic already nested under sacrifice and expulsion/purification patterns.
suggestions.cautions: Confirm whether the substitute is ritually expelled, sacrificed, or merely a narrative decoy; secondary sacred_exchange may apply.

suggestions.label: Transmission and migration of story collections
suggestions.rationale: This describes textual/history-of-tradition movement rather than a narrative or symbolic motif.
suggestions.cautions: Preserve as provenance or reception metadata; do not treat as evidence of motif transmission in pattern queries.

suggestions.label: Transmission and reattribution of tale collections
suggestions.rationale: The label concerns attribution and textual transmission history, not a motif within the stories.
suggestions.cautions: May be useful for source-critical notes, but should be excluded from Pattern Explorer motif queries.

suggestions.label: Transmission of mystical poetry across cultures
suggestions.rationale: This is a reception/transmission claim about poetic traditions rather than a symbolic motif.
suggestions.cautions: Keep separate from mystical_quest or sacred_song unless a passage itself dramatizes sacred song or mystical transformation.

suggestions.label: Transmission of romance through adaptation and translation
suggestions.rationale: Adaptation and translation history is a scholarly/textual artifact, not a recurring narrative motif.
suggestions.cautions: Do not infer historical contact here; retain as bibliographic or transmission metadata if needed.

suggestions.label: transported spectator or hearer
suggestions.rationale: The phrase could mean ecstatic transport by hearing/seeing, physical relocation, or a literary audience effect.
suggestions.cautions: Source context is needed before mapping to dream_and_vision, theophany, storytelling_as_power, or otherworld.

suggestions.label: trap reversal through feigned ignorance
suggestions.rationale: Feigning ignorance to reverse a trap is a deception and boundary-crossing strategy typical of trickster-like episodes.
suggestions.cautions: If no liminal/trickster figure is present, this may be a general clever-escape tale detail rather than a sacred motif.

suggestions.label: treasure secret withheld after brother's heart is shown
suggestions.rationale: The label combines kinship, treasure secrecy, and a violent body-part episode in a highly specific narrative detail.
suggestions.cautions: May relate to sacred_treasures, forbidden_knowledge, sacred_combat, or sibling_pair depending on passage function; avoid broad mapping from label alone.
suggested_aliases: treasure knowledge withheld after kin murder

suggestions.label: treasure theft by eloping pair
suggestions.rationale: The motif centers on theft of a treasure/power object, with elopement as the narrative circumstance.
suggestions.cautions: If the emphasis is illicit flight or romance rather than the object's power, sacred_love or hero_journey may be secondary; if divine/forbidden theft is central, sacred_theft may be better.

suggestions.label: Triadic naming and equipment pattern
suggestions.rationale: Triadic naming/equipment may be a Celtic literary-formula artifact, an identity marker, or a sacred-object pattern.
suggestions.cautions: Review passage evidence before mapping to sacred_treasures, hero_journey, or excluding as a stylistic/textual artifact.

batch_notes: Several labels in this batch are transmission or reception-history artifacts; these should be kept out of motif pattern queries and handled as provenance metadata.
For single-occurrence, highly episode-specific labels, preserve the granular wording as evidence notes rather than promoting new canonical groups.

reviewer_status.notes: Provisional placements only; human review recommended especially for ambiguous narrative-strategy and over-specific labels.

suggestions.label: tribal patron celestial body
suggestions.rationale: Could describe a tutelary celestial body, astral sign, tribal identity marker, or local cult/patronage motif; existing groups do not identify the function from the label alone.
suggestions.cautions: Single occurrence and culturally/contextually dependent; do not map to cosmic_origin or divine_intervention without evidence of creation, guidance, or active patron agency.

suggestions.label: tripartite cosmic realm
suggestions.rationale: A three-level cosmos of heaven, earth, and underworld is the spatial structure presupposed by axis-mundi motifs connecting realms.
suggestions.cautions: If the passage only catalogs cosmological doctrine without a connecting center or passage between realms, preserve as cosmology evidence rather than a narrative motif.

suggestions.label: triple funeral procession
suggestions.rationale: The label describes a structured funerary procession, fitting ritual memorialization of the dead.
suggestions.cautions: The 'triple' detail may be episode-specific; if no heroic or social-order function is present, it may be too granular for broad pattern queries.

suggestions.label: True figure identified among identical claimants
suggestions.rationale: This may be a recognition test, discernment of true identity, illusion episode, or miracle display; existing groups do not clearly capture the function.
suggestions.cautions: Could belong with sacred_knowledge if discernment is central, shapeshifter if forms are altered, or divine_intervention if miraculous authentication is central; source context needed.

suggestions.label: true form hidden beneath encrustation
suggestions.rationale: A concealed true form beneath an outer layer fits transformation, disguise, or revealed identity imagery.
suggestions.cautions: If the encrustation is merely an object-restoration detail or art-historical description, exclude or treat as evidence note rather than motif.

suggestions.label: true friend needed in adversity
suggestions.rationale: The motif concerns relational loyalty and support under trial, which broadly fits reciprocal obligation and ethical relationship.
suggestions.cautions: May be an ethical maxim rather than a mythic motif; if framed as mystical companionship or guide-disciple loyalty, mystical_quest may be a better secondary context.

suggestions.label: true religion measured by care for vulnerable people
suggestions.rationale: Care for vulnerable people as a test of religion fits sacred ethical law and the existing social_care child pattern.
suggestions.cautions: If the passage is purely doctrinal commentary, preserve as teaching evidence; do not over-read as narrative action.
suggested_aliases: true piety as care for the weak

suggestions.label: tyranny answered by banquet ambush and tribal retaliation
suggestions.rationale: The label describes retaliatory violence against tyranny, but the banquet ambush and tribal details are highly episode-specific.
suggestions.cautions: Could instead be political vengeance, moral judgment, or narrative plot detail; verify whether warfare/retaliation has sacred or tribal-order significance before indexing.

suggestions.label: tyrant's generalized vengeance after betrayal
suggestions.rationale: A tyrant's excessive vengeance after betrayal can function as overreaching power that invites moral critique or downfall.
suggestions.cautions: If no downfall or humbling follows, this may be a villain-action plot detail rather than a reusable motif; sacred_combat or divine_judgment may fit if retaliation is central.

suggestions.label: unarmed boastful wrestler defeated after incitement
suggestions.rationale: The motif centers on a combat contest in which a boastful opponent is defeated, fitting heroic or ritualized combat.
suggestions.cautions: The unarmed, wrestler, and incitement details are likely episode-specific; if moral humbling is emphasized, pride_and_downfall may be a secondary placement.

batch_notes: All suggestions are provisional placements based on labels only; single-occurrence items with strong episode detail should remain low-priority for canonical promotion.
Several items in this batch are ethical maxims or political-violence plot details; reviewers should verify source evidence before enabling broad Pattern Explorer queries.

reviewer_status.notes: Provisional normalization suggestions generated from supplied taxonomy and group index.

suggestions.label: unattainable object disparaged after failure
suggestions.rationale: This resembles a fable or moral-psychological pattern rather than a clear existing mythic motif group.
suggestions.cautions: Single occurrence; may be an Aesopic narrative detail or proverb-like artifact. Source context needed before mapping to wisdom, pride/downfall, or exclusion.

suggestions.label: Unbidden guest at a feast
suggestions.rationale: An uninvited feast guest may signal disrupted hospitality, divine intrusion, conflict catalyst, or comic episode depending on context.
suggestions.cautions: Do not map to sacred_exchange without evidence that hospitality obligation or sacred reciprocity is central. Single occurrence may be episode-specific.

suggestions.label: uncanny red chariot company
suggestions.rationale: The label combines supernatural company, color symbolism, and vehicle imagery without enough functional information.
suggestions.cautions: Could be otherworldly visitation, battle omen, divine retinue, or over-specific scene detail. Preserve color and chariot details as evidence until context is reviewed.

suggestions.label: uncertain founder or author figure
suggestions.rationale: The wording describes uncertainty about attribution or identity rather than a narrative motif.
suggestions.cautions: If the source passage narrates a culture founder, map that evidence separately to culture_hero; if it concerns authorship attribution, keep as provenance only.

suggestions.label: unchanged total transformed by changed presentation
suggestions.rationale: This reads as an abstract philosophical formulation rather than a stable narrative motif.
suggestions.cautions: Could relate to Daoist paradox, non-action, duality, or wisdom teaching, but the label is too conceptual without passage evidence.

suggestions.label: unconsumed or non-burning flame imagery
suggestions.rationale: Non-consuming flame is a distinctive sacred-fire image of divine presence, purity, or spiritual power.
suggestions.cautions: If the passage is purely poetic metaphor with no ritual, divine, or transformative function, keep as evidence detail rather than broad motif.

suggestions.label: underestimated youthful champion
suggestions.rationale: A youth whose hidden power is underestimated fits the extraordinary child or youthful destiny pattern.
suggestions.cautions: If the emphasis is combat achievement rather than sacred childhood signs, secondary review under divine_warrior or hero_journey may be appropriate.

suggestions.label: underground supernatural smiths and miners
suggestions.suggested_group_label: Sacred Craft and Divinely Aided Construction
suggestions.rationale: Supernatural smiths and miners center on sacred craft, subterranean production, and power-object making.
suggestions.cautions: If the passage emphasizes their otherworldly dwelling or race identity more than craft, otherworld or divine_race may be better secondary mappings.

suggestions.label: unequal alliance in the hunt
suggestions.rationale: The motif depends on whether the hunt functions as ordeal, social hierarchy, animal encounter, or conflict catalyst.
suggestions.cautions: No current group cleanly covers hunting alliance motifs. Single occurrence may be an episode-specific relational detail.

suggestions.label: unexpected food-bearer after deprivation
suggestions.rationale: A sudden provider after deprivation may function as supernatural aid or providential intervention.
suggestions.cautions: If no sacred or supernatural agency is present, this may be a journey-provision episode or hospitality detail rather than divine intervention.

batch_notes: Several labels in this batch are single-occurrence and highly contextual; source evidence should decide whether they are motifs or episode details.
Hospitality, hunting, and fable-like labels may need future groups only if recurrence across traditions is demonstrated.

reviewer_status.notes: Provisional placements only; human review recommended for ambiguous single-occurrence items.
